panels.title: How to read this — and what to do about it

options.content:
**Read top-down. Stop at the first stage that is red — that is your binding constraint. Everything below it is a symptom, not a cause.**

| # | Stage | Red when | What it means | Do this |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **SUPPLY** | `Clean live labels` flat or < 30 | The loop is starved. No amount of model work matters — there is nothing to learn from. | Check `Live labels` beside it: if live is climbing and clean is not, hygiene is eating the rows, so read `Label uniqueness`. If both are flat, the bot is not closing trades. |
| 2 | **CORPUS** | `Era exclusion` ACTIVE with `New-era rows` < 150, or uniqueness < 0.05 | You have rows but they do not count. Overlapping horizons mean N labels carry far less than N labels of evidence (AFML ch. 4 — sample weights redistribute so overlap cannot double-count). | Wait for new-era rows to reach 150, or shorten the label horizon. A corpus of 274 rows at uniqueness 0.05 is an effective sample near 14. |
| 3 | **QUALITY** | `Brier` at or above baseline, or `Calibration gap` widening | The model is not beating the base rate, or its probabilities are not the thing they claim to be. Kelly reads probabilities literally, so a calibration error is a *sizing* error. | Compare against `champion` on the Brier chart. If live is worse than baseline, the honest move is to stand the model down, not retune it. |
| 4 | **GOVERNOR** | `Model in use` NO while 1–3 are green | The model earned its place and is still muted. | This is usually correct — a stand-down, not a fault. Check the governor level on VITALS before overriding anything. |

**When all four are green and it still loses money**, the constraint is not learning — it is geometry. A selector cannot harvest an edge smaller than costs: check cost per round trip against horizon sigma (`scripts/horizon_bootstrap.py`) and the gate's realized separation (`scripts/gate_efficacy_report.py`). At a 2-hour horizon this bot paid 0.82 sigma per round trip and no selector could win; the fix was the horizon, not the model.

*Sample-size discipline throughout: prefer `Win rate LCB` (Wilson lower bound) to the point estimate, and treat any conclusion drawn from fewer than ~30 clean live labels as a hypothesis rather than a finding.*

panels.title: New-era rows
panels.description: 4/4 SUPPLY · Corpus rows tagged the NEW label era (triple_barrier). Arms the era exclusion at 150 (min_new_era_rows) — the floor past which old-era rows stop training the model.

panels.title: Label uniqueness
panels.description: CORPUS · Mean average-uniqueness (AFML ch.4): 1 = every label an independent fact; near 0 = heavily overlapping horizons (weights redistribute so overlap can't double-count). A big label count with low uniqueness is a small sample wearing a big number.

panels.title: Era exclusion
panels.description: CORPUS · ACTIVE = old-era rows (legacy/exit_sim/exit_sim_time_stop), INCLUDING live, are excluded from training — see liquiditybot_era_excl_dropped for the row count.

panels.title: Batch prior skew
panels.description: CORPUS · ML-074: trailing-window label prior vs corpus prior — SKEWED = a one-sided batch (e.g. all-zero quiet weekend) is moving calibration; detection only, weights untouched.

panels.title: Learning rows by label (live vs candidate)
panels.description: Ground-truth LIVE (real closed-trade) labels vs CANDIDATE (triple-barrier proxy) labels accruing over time — the learning loop turning. LIVE climbing past 35 = ML-073 realizing ground truth; a flat LIVE line = the loop is starved. Empty means: no labelled rows yet.

panels.title: Brier — live vs champion vs baseline (lower = better)
panels.description: Rolling outcome Brier: live vs deployed champion vs the base-rate baseline the model must undercut. Above the baseline means the model is worse than guessing the base rate. Empty means: window filling (<15 model-scored closes); not in this cycle's status write.

panels.title: Label rate by era
panels.description: Per-era label rate on the surviving corpus — the instrument that shows the 0.0066 (exit_sim_time_stop) -> 0.3991 (triple_barrier) repair as the new era takes over. Empty means: awaiting first retrain (no corpus load).

panels.title: Label supply — is training data arriving?
panels.description: The three label pools over time. live_clean gates retraining; it was pinned at 0 for thirteen days and no tile could show that. FLAT is the alarm here, not the all-clear. Empty means: no labelled rows yet; awaiting first retrain (no corpus load).

panels.title: Era exclusion — progress toward re-arming
panels.description: New-era rows against the min_rows threshold that arms era-gated training. Both are plotted so the GAP is the visible quantity — distance to the threshold is what you actually want to read, and two separate tiles make you subtract by hand. Empty means: awaiting first retrain (no corpus load).

panels.title: Calibration quality — is the model honest?
panels.description: A gap that WIDENS while labels accumulate means the model is learning the wrong thing — the one failure mode that looks identical to healthy progress on a state tile. Empty means: window filling (<15 model-scored closes); awaiting first retrain (no corpus load).

panels.title: Admission funnel — is the gate passing anything?
panels.description: A gate whose admitted line rides at zero while evaluated climbs is selecting against itself — which is what scripts/gate_efficacy_report.py measured at -12.2% separation. The divergence is the signal; neither line alone shows it. Empty means: conviction ledger not written.

panels.title: Mode
panels.description: share_cap = legacy SZ-047 rolling share cap (byte-identical, the escape hatch); budget = SPB-R scarcity-priced token bucket. The flip is a conscious operator config change + restart.

panels.title: Tokens now
panels.description: Token bucket level; negative = bounded placement debt (floor −C by construction, refill climbs it out).

panels.title: Labels/day (24h)
panels.description: Probe closes realized in the trailing 24h — the program's headline number. Book ceiling is 15/day (5 slots × 24h / 8h label horizon); expected ≈ 11-12 at defaults in budget mode.

panels.title: Unlock ETA
panels.description: max(0, 60 − tb-era labels) / labels-per-day: days to the 60-label tb-era evidence milestone at the current rate.

panels.title: Governor factor
panels.description: Tuition-governor refill scale: 1.0 nominal; < 1 = trailing-24h clipped probe losses crossed the cap (SZ-053); floored at 0.25 and self-redeeming as the window rolls — probation, never a life sentence.

panels.title: Tuition vs cap (24h)
panels.description: Trailing-24h clipped probe tuition as % of the daily cap (10 bps of equity). Per-close clip = cap/3, so one outlier can never engage the governor alone.

panels.title: Token bucket vs capacity
panels.description: Bucket level vs capacity C (= one book-fill, 5 tokens at defaults). Time below zero is bounded placement DEBT (worst −C ≈ 8h of refill); pinned at C = arrivals are cheaper than supply — headroom. Empty means: no probe-budget telemetry yet.

panels.title: Avg admission cost (24h)
panels.description: Mean scarcity price of admitted probes. Drift toward 1.0 = buying scarce labels (good); toward the clamp = only redundant arms arriving. Empty means: awaiting first probe admit.

panels.title: Admissions (24h)
panels.description: Budget-mode admission flow: admits vs the ~12/day target, SZ-052 refunds (unfilled entries hand their cost back), exhausted-bucket denials (SZ-049 brackets), and failed affordability rolls (non-dispositions — counters, not audit spam).

panels.title: Per-asset eff weight (taper × scarcity)
panels.description: The ONE combined per-asset drag number (stats-judge note): label-share taper pass-prob × scarcity weight S(a,r), normalized — never two invisible multiplications. Both factors floored, so no arm can reach zero.

panels.title: Per-regime live labels
panels.description: LIVE labels per regime vs the 60-per-regime coverage floor (corpus_target 300 / 5 regimes) — under-floor regimes hold the decay AND price cheap (same direction, no fight).
